title: Towards Understanding and Mitigating Social Biases in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using counterfactual context replacement (e.g., male vs. female terms) to evaluate local bias via f-divergence (KL divergence and Hellinger distance) on next-token probability distributions, and global bias via sentiment and regard classifiers on fully generated sentences. Also evaluated using the StereoSet benchmark.

Measured using counterfactual context replacement (e.g., Muslim, Christian, and Jewish terms) to evaluate local bias via divergence metrics on next-token probabilities, and global bias by comparing sentiment and regard scores of generated text. Also evaluated using the StereoSet benchmark.
